start_here: Say to your AI: "Show me every tour in my workspace and which ones I have finished", with {}. It runs tool:list-workspace-tours and answers {"tours":[{"tour_id":"sample-tour","title":"Sample tour","summary":"","steps":1,"finished":false,"start_event":{"event_kind":"app-opened","walkthrough_id":"sample-tour"},"changed_at":null,"own":true}],"said":"1 tour, 0 finished."}
no_lists_because: It names no list of yours: it takes its input and keeps only its own rows (@own-records) through the records door.
instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Show me every tour in my workspace and which ones I have finished", and give it nothing more: every input is optional.
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:list-workspace-tours and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: Reads the tours your AIs wrote (guided-overlay::own-walkthroughs) and your tour progress, with the app's own tours when the caller passes them as tours, and answers each tour in its order: tour_id, title, summary, steps, finished, the event that starts it by name (start_event), when the change it shows landed (changed_at) and whether it is one of your own.
4. It reads and writes only its own rows through the records door: @own-records (workspace:read); @own-records (workspace:read); @own-records (workspace:read).
